Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
457 PM EDT Sun Sep 20 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT MONDAY MORNING...

.REST OF THIS AFTERNOON...S winds 10 kt. Waves 2 ft. Isolated
showers and tstms. 
.TONIGHT...SW winds 5 to 10 kt...becoming N 10 to 15 kt after
midnight. Waves 2 ft. Scattered showers and tstms. 
.MON...NE winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.MON NIGHT...E winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft.
Widespread showers. 
.TUE...NE winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Waves 3 ft.
Showers.
.TUE NIGHT...NE winds 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Waves 3 ft. Showers
likely. 
.WED...NE winds 20 to 25 kt. Waves 3 ft. Showers likely, mainly in
the morning. 
.THU...NE winds 20 to 25 kt. Waves 3 ft. A chance of showers in the
morning.  

Winds and waves higher and visibilities lower in and near tstms.
